symptom: the security report flags a callable flow high although its sub-microflows show it is not (Shop.DS_Info_Line on ako/PizzaV1: takes a Product, creates the caller's own cart line), and labels flows that commit the parameter's entity in a sub as reading only
cause: collectCallableFlows looked at the flow's own body only, and 'writes' meant any write to any entity; entity access off + any write was high whatever the parameter entity's read rule
insight: Follow the call closure, but judge it on the entities the flow takes: a sub that stamps [%CurrentUser%] on a Toast turned 19 PizzaV1 flows 'ok' in a first cut, and creating one's own cart line is not changing what the client chose. The client can only pass objects its role may read, so entity access off + a write is high only when the read rule is 'all'; otherwise the read rule bounds it (PizzaV1's hand review: 'only the guest's own rows'). Compare a new verdict rule against a hand-reviewed app before trusting it
